checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.why: Dark sky, lit lamps, dark scene.

must.item: Street and shop architecture retain shapes and positions
must.why: Layout is matched; minor detail changes in shop interiors and signage.

must.item: Pedestrian on right same pose and blue jacket

must.why: Warm windows, lamps glow, cool blue shadows; no sun remains.

must.item: Wide composition preserved, no new subjects/objects
must.why: Same framing; no new subjects; the woman by the shops is kept.

faults.what: Shop window interiors and signage were redrawn with different contents, e.g. the posters and shelves; the pink shop sign is darkened and its text is unreadable.
Upper buildings on the left are almost black and lose detail; the background tree is nearly lost.

summary: The output is a convincing night version of the same street with both people kept in place; only small details in the shop windows and signs changed.
